findings.description: The Lambda environment embeds an AWS access key ID and secret access key directly in Terraform. This exposes credential material through source control, Terraform state, plans, and Lambda configuration readers; use a runtime IAM role and a secrets manager instead.

The function uses nodejs12.x, an end-of-life runtime that no longer receives security updates. Known runtime or dependency vulnerabilities may remain exploitable by function inputs or code execution paths.
